newsitem.title: USA: Eclipse moves to Phase II TMR trial.
newsitem.headline: Eclipse moves to Phase II TMR trial.

text.p: Eclipse Surgical Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to start a Phase II trial of its transmyocardial revascularization procedure.
The trial is using the procedure as an adjunct to bypass surgery.

Transmyocardial revascularization, or TMR, is a surgical procedure performed on the beating heart, in which a laser device is used to create pathways through the heart muscle directly into the heart chamber. The pathways are intended to allow improved blood flow to the oxygen-starved muscle.
It is the company's second Phase II trial. The first is evaluating TMR as sole therapy for patients who are not candidates for balloon angioplasty or bypass surgery.
